test_title: PYST 32: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding the 2024 Haryana Assembly elections are correct?

1. The BJP formed the government for a third consecutive term in Haryana.

2. The Indian National Lok Dal (INLD) secured 2 seats in the election.

3. Independent candidates secured more than 5 seats in the assembly.

4. The majority mark in the Haryana Legislative Assembly was 48 seats.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 and 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **2024 Haryana Assembly Elections**, the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** formed the government for the **third consecutive term** in the state. ***Hence, Statement 1 is correct.***
 
• The **Indian National Lok Dal (INLD)** secured **2 seats** in the Haryana Legislative Assembly elections. ***Hence, Statement 2 is correct.***
 
• **Independent candidates** did not secure more than **5 seats** in the election. ***Hence, Statement 3 is incorrect.***
 
• The **Haryana Legislative Assembly** has a total of **90 seats**, and the majority mark required to form the government is **46 seats**, not 48. ***Hence, Statement 4 is incorrect.***
 
• **Statement-wise Analysis:**
 
 
• **1. BJP formed the government for a third consecutive term** – Correct.
 
• **2. INLD secured 2 seats** – Correct.
 
• **3. Independent candidates secured more than 5 seats** – Incorrect.
 
• **4. Majority mark was 48 seats** – Incorrect.
 
 
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Only 1 and 2.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Haryana Legislative Assembly** is a **unicameral legislature** consisting of **90 elected members**.
 
• The term of the Haryana Assembly is generally **5 years** unless dissolved earlier.
 
• **Chandigarh** serves as the capital of both **Haryana** and **Punjab**.
 
• **Indian National Lok Dal (INLD)** is a regional political party mainly active in Haryana and was founded by **Devi Lal**.
 
• The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** conducts Assembly elections under the provisions of the **Constitution of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **majority mark** in any legislative assembly is calculated as **more than half** of the total seats.
 
• Questions related to **recent elections, constitutional bodies, political parties, and state legislatures** are frequently asked in competitive examinations.
